source.binary: libUnreal.so pulled from the live TFT PBE process mapping

methodology.xref: AArch64 ADRP/ADD reference passed as x1 to the console-variable reference constructor at 0x32635cc, or to the integer constructor at 0x32639e8
methodology.default_decode: referenced .data storage is decoded from the final ELF LOAD segment using its 0xc000 VMA-to-file offset delta; stack-backed defaults are decoded from the explicit store before registration
methodology.runtime_check: the referenced .data words were also read from /proc/PID/mem in a live control process after verifying the loaded library hash
methodology.scope: compiled and live referenced defaults only; console priority or later runtime code may still override them

observations.evidence: ELF bytes at file offset 0xb9ec9b8 and the live control storage are both 01000000
observations.help: allow parallel ticking of particle systems.
If 1, particle system components that can run async will be scheduled earlier in the frame.

observations.evidence: ELF bytes at file offset 0xb9ecbc0 and the live control storage are both 20000000
observations.help: When FX.BatchAsync = 1, controls the number of particle systems grouped together for threading.

decision.boundary: These FX CVars do not establish Niagara behavior; Riot uses Niagara and Cascade paths may both be present.
